{{Top|leg}}
Among the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], specially trained '''evacuation officers''' served with [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] to oversee the safe evacuation of high-priority bases. One such evacuation [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shawn Valdez]], whose efficiency ensured the safe evacuation of more than 86 percent of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] personnel during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
